condition: read_parquet on a public s3:// file fails with an OSError (ACCESS_DENIED) when AWS credentials are set in the environment, because it skips the anonymous-retry fallback that read_csv uses.
workaround: Pass storage_options={"anon": True} for public buckets, or unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID/AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY; some users pinned pandas 2.0.3.
